Article 1.4: Fees at a Glance

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Fee Type	Amount	When It Applies
Account purchase	$148 to $750	Paid once when you buy an account. Prices by account size are in Article 1.3.
Evaluation reset	Standard MAX: $100 at every size. STEADY: $114 to $620 by account size (see Article 6.1). Discounts via Discord.	Any time you choose to reset an active evaluation
Exhibition reset	$312.50 – $3,125	If you fail exhibition and want to retry without restarting evaluation
Funded reset (Standard MAX and STEADY)	$475 – $3,125	If you have not received a payout and you failed your Sim Funded account, you can reset it one time only. Exact fee depends on account size.
Payout fee	None	FFN charges no fees on payouts
Payment processing fee	3.5%	A 3.5% fee applies to each payout withdrawal via Rise, Wise, or PayPal. Minimum withdrawal $250.
FFN Institution market data fee	TBD	Applies to FFN Institution accounts only and does not apply to Sim Funded accounts. It is paid from your Institution account balance and is not charged to your credit card.
DISCOUNTS: Daily reset fee discounts are posted in the FFN Discord server. Join at: discord.gg/T5GpWm7cF8 Promotional codes (e.g. 50% off + BOGO) are announced via email, Discord, and the FFN website. Always check for active promotions before purchasing.
